name: KittyTalk
author: Jenna Studio
description: A minimal Sanrio x Apple look for KakaoTalk on iOS: predominantly white, black outlines and typography, red (#E6002D) as the only accent, with a little bow as the one recurring motif.

fonts.note: KakaoTalk renders in-app text in the system font; the .ktheme format has no font property. Bundled fonts are used only for the wordmark and preview artwork.

note: This manifest is source metadata only. A KakaoTalk .ktheme package contains KakaoTalkTheme.css + Images/ at the archive root; manifest.json is not included in the package.
